budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Bring the single relic to your team base with your runner carrying and your scout simultaneously co-signing nearby, while the other team can intercept.
task.natural_termination: One team natural-completes when its runner stands exactly on its base holding the relic and its adjacent scout also chooses CO-SIGN, with neither hit by an unprotected tag that turn.
task.interaction: A scout public lantern reveals information to both teams; coordinated screens prevent enemy tags, tags stun and drop carried relics, paired handoffs exchange cargo, and extraction needs both teammates in space and time.
task.observation_access: Public fixed map, bases, active lantern positions/lifetimes and alarm/claim/extraction announcements. Scouts see agents and relic within Manhattan radius 4; runners see agents within 2 and recognize relic within 1. Any active lantern makes agents/relic within 3 visible to everyone, through walls by the stated radio-scan rule.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Public per-team notice that a pickup occurred this transition
Public per-team number of agents actually stunned this transition
Public teams that have ever held the relic; at most once per team
Jointly co-signed extraction on the final live transition

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
